description: This file contains utility functions for resolving configuration parameters related to Anthropic Vertex, including region, project ID, credentials, and authentication status, primarily for cloud environment setup.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalSecretInput
methods.description: Normalizes an input value to a string or undefined, trimming whitespace if input is a string.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexRegion
methods.description: Resolves the Anthropic Vertex region based on environment variables or defaults to 'global'.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexProjectId
methods.description: Resolves the project ID for Anthropic Vertex from environment variables or ADC credentials.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexRegionFromBaseUrl
methods.description: Extracts the region from the provider endpoint based on the base URL.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexClientRegion
methods.description: Determines the client region based on base URL or environment variables.

methods.name: hasAnthropicVertexMetadataServerAdc
methods.description: Checks if ADC metadata server is explicitly opted-in via environment variable.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexDefaultAdcPath
methods.description: Determines the default ADC credentials path based on platform.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexAdcCredentialsPathCandidate
methods.description: Resolves the path to ADC credentials, prioritizing environment variable.

methods.name: canReadAnthropicVertexAdc
methods.description: Checks if ADC credentials file can be read successfully.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexProjectIdFromAdc
methods.description: Extracts project ID from ADC credentials JSON file.

methods.name: hasAnthropicVertexCredentials
methods.description: Determines if valid credentials are available via metadata server or ADC file.

methods.name: hasAnthropicVertexAvailableAuth
methods.description: Checks if authentication credentials are available.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexConfigApiKey
methods.description: Returns a marker if credentials are available for API key configuration.
